chapter_label: Shaikh & Tonak 1987 Social Wage Myth Replication (ES1101-ES1103)

external_paper.author: Shaikh, Anwar and Tonak, E. Ahmet
external_paper.title: The Welfare State and the Myth of the Social Wage
external_paper.venue: In Cherry et al. (eds.), The Imperiled Economy, Book I (URPE), pp. 184-194

evidence.transcription_size: Single consolidated full_transcription.md (paper is short — 11 pages pp.184-194)
evidence.critical_sections_covered: Empirical Methodology pp.186-187 (Group I/II classifications, NT formula, B/T allocation rules); Table 2 p.192 (34 annual values 1952-1985); Appendix Table 1 p.191 (1964 worked example); Figure 2 and Figure 3 descriptions p.188-190 (benefit-rate and net-transfer-rate trajectories); Notes 6,8,9,11,12 pp.193-194
evidence.verbatim_anchors: ES1101: 3 verbatim quotes covering NT=B-T_w formula (p.186), negative-over-period claim, and Phase 3 endpoint -11.0% in 1985 (p.190). ES1102: 3 verbatim quotes covering benefit numerator construction, 1985-below-1966 finding, and Figure 2 trajectory (11%/20%/33%/31%/20%). ES1103: 3 verbatim quotes covering tax numerator construction, 1984 peak (41% above 1966), and Figure 2 tax-rate trajectory (17%/22%/24%/31%)

L1_kb_completeness.notes: KB transcription is comprehensive for the entire 11-page paper. Single-file transcription pattern (vs chunk-by-chunk for the 1984 dissertation) is appropriate for the paper's length. All three series have verbatim numeric anchors for V03 validation.

evidence.external_csv_paths: Inputs/ST2/Inputs/ExternalSources/Tonak1984/ shares the underlying BEA Survey of Current Business 1981 tables used by ST 1987; no dedicated 1987-folder CSVs found
evidence.cached_BEA_NIPA: 17 BEA NIPA files at Inputs/ST2/Inputs/API_Data/BEA/ including nipa_3_1_govt_receipts_expenditures.csv, nipa_3_2_federal_govt.csv, nipa_3_3_state_local_govt.csv, nipa_T20100_compensation_1929_2025.csv — covers entire 1952-1985 ST 1987 period
evidence.BLS_FRED_cache: BLS production-worker series + FRED TCU capacity-utilization cached
evidence.table_2_values_in_KB: Annual 1952-1985 values for B, T_w, and NT in billions USD are embedded in the KB full_transcription.md (Table 2 p.192) — directly extractable to a CSV during Stage 3 ingestion
evidence.no_dedicated_ST1987_csv_yet: No table_2_NSW_1952_1985.csv exists in ExternalSources/ — values must be parsed from KB or re-aggregated from NIPA

L2_data_source_availability.notes: Underlying BEA NIPA data is fully cached. The 34-year ST 1987 Table 2 series (B, T_w, NT) is recoverable from the KB transcription. A dedicated digitized CSV would be a Stage 3 improvement but is not blocking — the methodology is to derive ES1101-ES1103 from S604/S605/EC inputs, which are themselves NIPA-cached.

evidence.ES1101_methodology_summary: Populated and precise: '(B_w - T_w) / EC, 1952-1985 (34 years)' with full Group I/II breakdown and phase structure documented
evidence.ES1102_methodology_summary: Populated and precise: 'B_w / EC, 1952-1985 (34 years)' with full Group I (4 items, 100% allocation) + Group II (7 items, labor-share allocation) classification
evidence.ES1103_methodology_summary: Populated and precise: 'T_w / EC, 1952-1985 (34 years)' with full Group I/II tax classification, Bowles-Gintis comparison caveat, employer-SS double-counting note
evidence.formulas_present: All three series carry the exact ST 1987 formulas verbatim from p.186-187
evidence.appendix_table_1_worked_example: 1964 values fully populated in all three research JSONs (B=68.01bn from E1=33.24 + E2_labor=34.77; T_w=74.52bn from Group I=28.66 + Group II=45.88)
evidence.phase_structure_documented: All three series document Phase 1 (1952-1969 boom), Phase 2 (1969-1975 crisis), Phase 3 (1975-1985 attack) with empirical anchors

L3_methodology_clarity.notes: Methodology documentation is exceptionally complete. All three series have full formula, classification, worked-example, and phase-structure documentation.

evidence.all_required_fields_present: ES1101, ES1102, ES1103 all have name, study, chapter, year_range, subseries, construction, validation, processor, wave, status, units, content_type
evidence.construction_with_formula: All three have op='derive' with explicit formula strings ((B_w-T_w)/EC, B_w/EC, T_w/EC) and inputs list (S604/S605/BEA_NIPA)
evidence.year_range_target_present: All three carry year_range_target [1952, 1985] matching the ST 1987 paper coverage
evidence.concurrent_series_ES1103: ES1103 carries concurrent_series block (CS1103-N, CS1103-D) documenting numerator/denominator decomposition — strong, but ES1101 and ES1102 lack analogous concurrent_series blocks
evidence.year_range_inconsistency: Registry year_range field is [1952, 1989] for all three but subseries period and year_range_target are [1952, 1985] — ST 1987 paper ends 1985

L4_registry_completeness.notes: Strong registry hygiene including formula-typed construction and year-range targets. Minor inconsistency: registry top-level year_range extends to 1989 while paper coverage ends 1985 (this may be intentional padding for extension margin but should be reconciled in Stage 3). ES1101 and ES1102 would benefit from concurrent_series blocks matching the ES1103 pattern.

evidence.tolerance_class_populated: All three have tolerance_class='share_series' with tolerance_rel=0.001, tolerance_abs=0.01

blockers: All three ES11xx series have validation.reference_values={} — V03 will pass trivially without numerical anchors
Hyper-review pattern (52/64 empty) confirmed for this chapter — 3/3 are empty
L5_validation_refs.notes: This is the chapter's primary weakness. Stage 3 ingestion MUST populate reference_values from KB verbatim anchors before Stage 5 V03 can be meaningful. All needed values exist in research JSONs and KB transcription.

evidence.all_content_type_time_series: ES1101, ES1102, ES1103 all content_type='time_series' — CORRECT (34 annual observations 1952-1985)
evidence.all_units_share: ES1101, ES1102, ES1103 all units='share' — CORRECT for rate quantities (NT/EC, B/EC, T/EC)
evidence.no_proxies: All three derive from S604/S605/EC, which themselves source from BEA NIPA — no proxy substitution required
evidence.extension_binary_invariant: All three have extension: null and no -EXT/-COMBINED subseries (per Decision 0003 binary rule)
evidence.status_book_period_validated: All three downgraded from 'validated_book_and_extension' to 'book_period_validated' in Hyper-review 2026-05-19 — correctly aligns with extension: null

L6_classification_accuracy.notes: Classification is clean across all three series.
